name: refmode
about: Referee mode: on the pitch in the referee's kit, three big buttons.

steps.js: const s = sc.s, pc = sc.pc; const k = Object.values(s.items).find(i => i.def === 'ref_kit' && i.loc.k !== 'worn'); if (!k) return 'no kit'; if (pc.worn.outer) { const o = s.items[pc.worn.outer]; o.loc = { k: 'gone' }; } k.loc = { k: 'worn', a: pc.id, slot: 'outer' }; pc.worn.outer = k.id; return 'kit on ' + s.match.phase
